Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates elevation of the right hemidiaphragm and a distinct scalloped or wavy contour of the left hemidiaphragm, without evidence of significant pleural effusion. This specific morphological finding of diaphragmatic scalloping is characteristic of lymphangioma (cystic hygroma) involving the diaphragm or subdiaphragmatic space.
